macros.name: customAIdisclose
macros.doc: The command \customAIdisclose{} allows users to formulate custom declarations that do not fit into the other methods.

macros.name: discloseAI
macros.doc: This package builds on the cleveref package to provide the command \discloseAI[]{}, which can be included in any indexed environment, such as a lemma, theorem or section to disclose the AI tool use for this specific part of the article.

macros.doc: The final AI disclosure is generated using the command \printAIdisclosure[], which will create an unindexed subsection called “AI contribution disclosure”.
